fields.Appearance: Young and sleep-deprived, with singed cuffs and notes written across both sleeves.
fields.Backstory: An apprentice reproduced a spell their teacher insists was never part of the assigned lesson.
fields.Goals: Understand who altered the lesson and master the spell before it harms someone.

fields.Appearance: Dressed in ordinary rural clothing decorated with discreet charms made from common materials.
fields.Backstory: A self-taught hedge mage has protected an isolated community using traditions dismissed by formal academies.
fields.Goals: Preserve the local practices and prove their worth without surrendering them to outsiders.

fields.Appearance: Ink-stained and absent-minded, carrying padded cases of instruments and carefully labeled samples.
fields.Backstory: A magical researcher recorded a result that challenges the institution funding the work.
fields.Goals: Repeat the experiment publicly and prevent the evidence from being destroyed.

fields.Appearance: Disciplined and guarded, wearing travel clothes over remnants of a reinforced casting uniform.
fields.Backstory: A battle mage deserted after being ordered to test an unstable ritual near civilians.
fields.Goals: Disable the ritual, rescue former comrades, and expose the officer who approved it.

fields.Appearance: Ceremonially marked, meticulously groomed, and surrounded by a faint scent of incense or ozone.
fields.Backstory: A ritual specialist inherited obligations to an unseen patron without receiving the promised instructions.
fields.Goals: Discover the patron's nature and renegotiate the obligations before the next payment is due.
